question: What is the main purpose of counseling in midwifery practice?

options.A: Helping patients process the emotional impact of illness
options.B: Telling the patient exactly how to manage their home life
options.C: Replacing medical treatments with psychological therapy
options.D: Diagnosing underlying psychiatric illnesses in pregnant women

explanation: Counseling supports the patient's emotional and psychological well-being regarding their health condition. [learn more](BMP122_U3_T3#BMP122_U3_T3_h1)

question: Why should a midwife avoid simply giving direct advice during counseling?

options.A: Patients need to explore their own feelings and solutions
options.B: Hospital policies strictly forbid midwives from talking
options.C: Medical doctors are the only ones allowed to give advice
options.D: Direct advice always causes severe psychological harm

explanation: Counseling empowers patients by helping them find workable solutions themselves rather than depending entirely on outside directives. [learn more](BMP122_U3_T3#BMP122_U3_T3_h1)

question: Which type of question requires more than a simple yes or no answer?
explanation: Open-ended questions encourage patients to elaborate on their thoughts and feelings rather than giving short, closed responses. [learn more](BMP122_U3_T3#BMP122_U3_T3_h2)

question: A pregnant woman looks worried and quiet. How does a midwife use reflection in this situation?

options.A: By changing the topic to something more cheerful
options.B: By immediately prescribing a mild sedative medication
options.C: By telling her everything will definitely be fine
options.D: By rephrasing the woman's words to confirm understanding

explanation: Reflection involves repeating or rephrasing what the patient expressed to show they are heard and understood. [learn more](BMP122_U3_T3#BMP122_U3_T3_h2)

question: What is the foundation of building trust during a patient counseling session?

options.A: Providing expensive gifts to the patient
options.B: Sharing personal stories about the midwife

explanation: Confidentiality ensures patients feel safe sharing private, sensitive information without fear of judgment or leakage. [learn more](BMP122_U3_T3#BMP122_U3_T3_h3)

question: Why is establishing early rapport so important for a pregnant woman attending antenatal care?

options.A: It encourages her to share hidden health concerns freely
options.B: It eliminates the need for any physical examinations
options.C: It prevents her from seeking care at any other clinic
options.D: It guarantees she will never experience labor complications

explanation: Good rapport makes the patient feel comfortable and secure, increasing the likelihood she will disclose important symptoms. [learn more](BMP122_U3_T3#BMP122_U3_T3_h3)

question: Which of the following is NOT a communication barrier in healthcare?

options.A: Using a shared local language fluently with the patient
options.B: A noisy and crowded antenatal clinic waiting room
options.C: High anxiety clouding a patient's understanding
options.D: Cultural beliefs misaligned with medical explanations

explanation: Speaking a language the patient understands fluently promotes communication rather than acting as a barrier. [learn more](BMP122_U3_T3#BMP122_U3_T3_h4)

question: How does a noisy, crowded hospital ward negatively affect patient counseling?

options.A: It improves the speed of medical documentation
options.B: It encourages patients to speak much louder
options.C: It automatically cures the patient's anxiety
options.D: It destroys privacy and distracts both parties

explanation: Environmental distractions and lack of privacy prevent patients from speaking openly about sensitive health issues. [learn more](BMP122_U3_T3#BMP122_U3_T3_h4)

question: What does professional autonomy require a midwife to do when a patient makes a personal health choice?

options.A: Respect and support the patient's informed choice
options.B: Force the patient to follow the midwife's personal beliefs
options.C: Refuse to provide any further medical care
options.D: Report the patient to local religious leaders

explanation: Patient autonomy means respecting the individual's right to make their own informed decisions regarding healthcare. [learn more](BMP122_U3_T3#BMP122_U3_T3_h5)

question: Why are dual relationships, such as counseling a close family member, discouraged in professional practice?

options.A: They always result in immediate legal prosecution
options.B: They make the hospital paperwork much easier to complete
options.C: Family members are legally barred from getting sick
options.D: They can impair the clinician's professional objectivity

explanation: Personal relationships blur boundaries and make it difficult to maintain the neutral, professional stance required for effective counseling. [learn more](BMP122_U3_T3#BMP122_U3_T3_h5)
